scope: Compiled-runtime and source-boundary inspection for protected ownership execution; before guest execution

findings.obligation: Saved restricted-register capabilities survive native invocation
findings.object_offsets: cbpf_test_invoke: stores 0x888/0x890, native call 0x8d4 (stats variant 0xa3c), reload/MSR 0x9e4..0x9f0
cbpf_consume: CLRTAG 0x644; store 0x648; atomic decrement LSE 0x6bc or LL/SC 0x77c..0x788
cbpf_gate_impl: exact equality 0x1a0; private tag 0x240..0x244; LDURSW through c0 0x26c
cbpf_exact 0x534..0x584 verifies exact bounds/permissions; acquire prepares both roots before refcount_inc call 0x394

findings.obligation: Full-capability gate transport and terminal failure
findings.object_offsets: cbpf_gateway: full c19..c22 saves/restores; SP restore 0x64..0x68; failure selects fixed executive CLR 0x6c..0x7c
cbpf_enter: RCSP 0xd7c, untagged RDDC 0xd80, input reloads 0xd84..0xd8c, SP reset 0xd94, BRR 0xda4

findings.source: intercept precedes stock JIT; unchanged runtime requires JIT for kfuncs; typed attachment, link creation/update, program-map insertion denied; program func_info metadata excluded

limits: Source/object inspection is not a compiler proof.
Linked code and actual native execution remain separate checks.
Initial DDC authority/provider assignment and inherited exception handling remain trusted.
No invalid BPF program, exploit, attachment probe or CVE was executed for this review.
